## 更新内容

- **专利挖掘**：重新排版「专利基本信息」，让专利名称和技术主题各占一行，并在较宽窗口中并排显示联系方式。字段旁的感叹号换成圆形信息图标，悬停或键盘聚焦可查看填写提示。
- **设置**：新版「关于」页将大横幅换成紧凑的应用图标和名称，让版本信息与检测入口更靠上。更新渠道名称简化为「GitCode」，用量统计页移除了顶部说明框。

## What's Changed

- **Patent mining** — The basic information form gives the patent title and technical topic a full row each and displays contact fields side by side in wider windows. Circular info icons replace exclamation marks and show field guidance on hover or keyboard focus.
- **Settings** — The modern About page uses a compact app header so version information and the update check are easier to reach. The update channel is labeled GitCode, and the introductory banner has been removed from Usage Statistics.
